observation_window.boundary_note: Every FY2019 flow and event is after the 2018-09-30 cutoff. Product-arena, issuer, industry-context and ordinary-share-cash boundaries remain typed separately.

industry_epoch.condition: Domestic white goods were entering slower category growth and stronger concentration, while portfolio companies combined product upgrades, channel work and other businesses.
industry_epoch.observed_concentration: Category leaders were disclosed, but no same-boundary concentration series was frozen.

mechanism_arenas.mechanism: Product, channel, price and installation capacity convert seasonal demand into air-conditioner sales and margin.
mechanism_arenas.value_driver: Product mix, sell-through, channel efficiency and unit margin.
mechanism_arenas.failure_mode: A hot season or low price can lift revenue without durable execution quality.

mechanism_arenas.mechanism: Product freshness, efficiency, brand and channel economics shape replacement demand and margin.
mechanism_arenas.value_driver: Volume, price-mix, brand investment, unit cost and working capital.
mechanism_arenas.failure_mode: Mix or acquisition can move reported revenue without organic customer preference.

mechanism_arenas.mechanism: Television, IT, intermediate products and portfolio actions alter consolidated revenue, margin and cash independently of white goods.
mechanism_arenas.value_driver: Business mix, perimeter, non-operating gains and capital allocation.
mechanism_arenas.failure_mode: Group improvement can be mistaken for white-goods operating quality.

members.cutoff_state: FY2017 air-conditioner and refrigerator revenue grew rapidly while product gross margin fell; group operating cash declined and the issuer retained television, IT, intermediate products and portfolio effects.
members.decision_heterogeneity: Management combined product launches, channel adjustment and organization reform inside a broader multi-business group, making boundary discipline the primary question.

strongest_common_rivals: Television, IT and intermediate-product performance can dominate consolidated movement.
Category cycle and product mix can lift white-goods revenue without better customer preference.
Portfolio disposals or acquisitions can alter group profit and cash without operating improvement.
unresolved_questions: Did white-goods revenue and gross margin move coherently after the cutoff?
Did disclosed product and channel work translate into execution rather than deployment?
Did consolidated cash fund required capital, and was any residual accessible to ordinary shares?
Did portfolio scope or leverage change the permanent-loss path?
